sources.title: The Funding Carry and a Cross-Venue Spread on Perpetual Futures: A Significance-Tested Study of Hyperliquid and Centralized Venues
sources.author: Tony Lau

hypothesis: Funding rates are persistent enough that a market-neutral portfolio long low/negative-funding perpetuals and short high-positive-funding perpetuals earns the subsequent realized funding differential plus residual price convergence.
universe: Intersection of local Binance funding histories and USD-M 1h perpetual prices, point-in-time availability; top 80% by lagged 30-day quote volume at each rebalance.
signal: Mean realized funding rate strictly before Monday 00:00 UTC over trailing window.
construction: Long bottom quartile signal / short top quartile, 0.5 gross each side.
holding: Monday 00:00 UTC to next Monday 00:00 UTC.
pnl: Perpetual price return plus realized funding cash flow: contribution = weight*price_return - weight*sum(funding_rates during holding interval).
fresh_confirmation: 2026 locked unless exploratory OOS success gates pass
development_gate: canonical net Sharpe >0.70, positive return, at least 2/3 windows positive
success_gate: canonical OOS net Sharpe >1, positive at 2x costs, >=2/3 windows positive, both OOS years non-negative, funding component positive
